description: PRD-199 S4 — seeded semantic doc for the A/B eval (semantic-on vs semantic-off). Canonical reader shape. The definitions deliberately AGREE with the goldens' interpretation: the A/B measures whether STATING the business vocabulary helps the LLM match the gold interpretation, so the doc must encode that interpretation, not contradict it.
instructions: Business vocabulary for this database: 'customers' are companies; a customer is ACTIVE when customers.status = 'active' and churned when status = 'churned'. 'Revenue' or 'total value' of orders means SUM(orders.total) over the orders in question — include every order regardless of status unless the question names a status (e.g. 'completed'). An order is COMPLETED when orders.status = 'completed', cancelled when 'cancelled', pending when 'pending'. Dates are ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings in orders.order_date; compare them as strings (e.g. order_date >= '2025-05-01'). 'Best-selling' means highest SUM(order_items.quantity). Product revenue means SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price).

total_revenue.description: Total order value; include all statuses unless a status is named

product_revenue.description: Revenue attributed to a product via its order items
